estimatedCardYears.summary: scripts/import-rlp-players.ts inferYearsActive() sets debutEstimate = birthYear + 18, and those RLP-imported historic cards use that estimate as their card season. In the 60-card sample, 21 cards had age exactly 18 and all 21 had the wrong season (most at a club the player had not yet joined, or never joined). Of the other 39, only 2 had a wrong season. 919 historic cards (37% of cards with birth data) show age exactly 18; the ids below are those with no source field. These cards need their season re-derived from the player's real first season at that club (RLP season lists) rather than birthYear+18. The birth years themselves are mostly right.

Confirmed wrong: Luke Polselli (joined 2026), Henry O'Kane (2026), Joe Cator (joined 2024), Reubenn Rennie (Toulouse from 2023 per RLP, so the 2022 card is wrong). The remaining players in the block were not checked.
